outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command: cd /app && ls -la && head -20 input.csv && echo "---EXPECTED---" && head -20 expected.csv && echo "---COUNTS---" && wc -l input.csv expected.csv

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import collections,re
with open('input.csv','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
print('size',len(data),'ends newline',data.endswith(b'\n'),'CR present',b'\r' in data)
# sample non-ascii
print('non-ascii',sum(1 for b in data if b>127))
lines=data.split(b'\n')
if lines and lines[-1]==b'': lines=lines[:-1]
print('lines',len(lines))
# count commas distribution
c=collections.Counter(l.count(b',') for l in lines)
print('comma counts',c.most_common(20))
# char set
chars=collections.Counter(data)
print('chars',sorted((chr(k),v) for k,v in chars.items() if k<128))
PY

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
mism=0
with open('input.csv') as fi, open('expected.csv') as fe:
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(fi,fe),1):
        a=a.rstrip('\n'); b=b.rstrip('\n')
        parts=[p.strip().upper() for p in a.split(',')]
        pred=';'.join(reversed(parts))+';OK'
        if pred!=b:
            mism+=1
            if mism<=10: print(i,repr(a),repr(b),repr(pred))
print('mismatches',mism)
PY

cd /app && cat > apply_macros.vim <<'EOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s//g\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\v([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
%normal! @a
%normal! @b
%normal! @c
wq
EOF
head -1000 input.csv > /tmp/test.csv
cp /tmp/test.csv /tmp/test.orig
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/test.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim; echo "exit=$?"
diff <(head -1000 expected.csv) /tmp/test.csv && echo MATCH
head -5 /tmp/test.csv | cat -A
cd /app && cp input.csv /tmp/input.orig.csv && time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es input.csv -S apply_macros.vim; echo "exit=$?"; cmp input.csv expected.csv && echo "BYTE MATCH"; wc -l input.csv
